`abstract class TweenEquation`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`BackTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/backtweenequation/), [`BounceTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/bouncetweenequation/), [`CircTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/circtweenequation/), [`CubicTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/cubictweenequation/), [`ElasticTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/elastictweenequation/), [`ExpoTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/expotweenequation/), [`LinearTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/lineartweenequation/), [`QuadTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quadtweenequation/), [`QuartTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quarttweenequation/), [`QuintTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/quinttweenequation/), [`SineTweenEquation`](/reference/animation/sinetweenequation/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TweenEquation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/TweenEquation.java)

Easing curve that turns the elapsed part of a step into its progress.

## Description

Pick one in [`TweenEquations`](/reference/animation/tweenequations/); extend this class for a curve of your own.

## Method details

<a id="TweenEquation-method-isValueOf"></a>

### isValueOf

`boolean isValueOf(String name)` 

If `true`, `name` is the name of this curve, as `toString()` gives it (`"Quad.OUT"`).

<a id="TweenEquation-method-compute"></a>

### compute

`float compute(float t)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the progress for `t`, the elapsed part of the step from `0F` to `1F`; it gives `0F` at the start and `1F` at the end, and may go past them on the way.
